annotations.title: Leave a plan on a position

description: Have TradeHub act on a held position later, with no agent connected: "close it if still open in 3 days", "tell me if its funding passes 50% a year", "close half below 94000". Up to 5 rules, each fired once: when price_above / price_below (mark), held_hours (since set) or funding_above (yearly rate it pays, 0.5 = 50%), then notify the person or close close_pct reduce-only. thesis: why it is open, what proves it wrong, for later sessions. Use right after entry, not your own timers. Not a stop-loss. A new plan replaces the old; rules=[] removes it. Next: get_my_open_positions.

rules.description: Up to 5 rules, each fires once; [] removes the plan

action.description: notify: tell the person (Telegram, events, webhooks); close: close close_pct of the position, reduce-only

value.description: USD per coin for prices; hours (0.1-720); funding as a yearly fraction (0.5 = 50%)

when.description: price_above / price_below: the mark crosses value; held_hours: value hours after the plan is set; funding_above: the yearly funding rate this position pays reaches value

thesis.description: Why the position is open and what would prove it wrong, for the next session to read back; seen only by you and the person

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid, else your only connected venue, else sandbox
